description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Layout' that serves as the main layout for a directory management system frontend. It includes a responsive sidebar navigation, a sticky topbar displaying the current section, and renders child components within the main content area. It also manages user authentication state for displaying different navigation links.

methods.name: Layout({ children })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the main layout with sidebar and topbar, managing navigation links based on user authentication status.
